fusions.name: Wringing Grip
fusions.desc: A crushing grip on a target up to 2 tiles away that deals 9 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Hindered] for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Seize and Turn
fusions.desc: Seizes up to 3 enemies within 3.5 tiles and turns them against each other for 4 seconds. Each takes 10 damage and is stunned for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Firm Hold
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Sure Fingers
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
